top_news.title: Meet the New Claude Opus 5: Frontier-Class Agentic Coding and Computer Use at Unchanged Opus Pricing
top_news.dek: Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5, a new flagship model that maintains existing pricing while offering performance near the higher-tier Claude Fable 5.
top_news.brief: Opus 5 replaces the 4.8 version as the top-tier model for Claude Pro and Max users. It features "thinking" enabled by default, which significantly alters API request handling compared to its predecessor. Pricing remains at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
top_news.image_alt: Claude Opus 5 branding and performance chart

top_news.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
top_news.dek: Prentis, an AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, is reportedly seeking $100 million to build computer-use agents for office automation.
top_news.brief: The startup focuses on training models to navigate routine software workflows and document systems. By targeting enterprise-level task automation, Prentis aims to move beyond standard coding assistants toward agents capable of direct computer control.
top_news.image_alt: Prentis AI lab logo and office workspace

top_news.title: [AINews] Claude Opus 5: Fable-level performance at Opus price (half Fable)
top_news.dek: Independent evaluations confirm Claude Opus 5 matches Fable-level performance, despite Anthropic's conservative official messaging.
top_news.brief: While Anthropic officially states Opus 5 "comes close" to Fable 5, independent benchmarks suggest it meets or exceeds that performance tier. The release highlights the ongoing challenge of accurately measuring model intelligence through standard evals.

top_news.title: What is Good? Extracting and Testing Implicit Theories of Literary Quality from LLM Reasoning Traces
top_news.dek: Researchers analyzed how LLMs evaluate literary quality, finding they prioritize intentionality over technical correctness.
top_news.brief: A study using DeepSeek models on a 30-text benchmark achieved 79.3% accuracy in classifying literary quality tiers. The model's reasoning traces revealed a consistent preference for intentionality, providing insight into how current LLMs implicitly define "good" writing.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing LLM reasoning traces for literary analysis

top_news.title: ModelExpress: Distributing Model Artifacts at the Speed of Light
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduced ModelExpress to reduce the latency and costs associated with distributing large model checkpoints across GPU clusters.
top_news.brief: As model weights reach hundreds of gigabytes, moving data for cold starts and autoscaling creates significant bottlenecks. ModelExpress aims to optimize the weight lifecycle, minimizing the time spent transferring artifacts before compute can begin.

primary.title: Kimi K3 trails frontier US models by a wide margin on cyber exploits, and distillation may explain why
primary.summary: The British AI Security Institute and the U.S. Center for AI Standards and Innovation tested Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 on offensive cyber tasks.
